tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The ground. Light (primary): the pale page of every format, fading into page-wash (bg-light). Dark (secondary): ink, the base under the dark background gradients (bg-midnight, bg-indigo).

tokens.name: page-wash
tokens.usage: Light grounds only: the soft periwinkle wash a light page fades into.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body. Light: ink on page and glass cards (17:1). Dark: white on the blue gradients.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: leads and card bodies on light (5.7:1 on page); the body paragraph on a dark slide.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Small JetBrains Mono labels and numbers: dream on light, periwinkle on dark. Dream on page measures 3.8:1 and periwinkle on the bright end of bg-indigo or bg-cobalt about 2.8:1, both under 4.5:1: keep labels on the dark part of a gradient, and set a label that must be read on light in primary.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The ONE highlight in an asset: primary on light (6.1:1 on page), aqua on dark. Never two.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Light grounds only: the glass card fill, white at 70% over the page.

tokens.name: card-border
tokens.usage: Light grounds only: the 1px white border of a glass card.

tokens.name: outline-on-dark
tokens.usage: Dark grounds only: the 1.5px outline of pills and tags on a slide.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block ground, on light and dark assets alike.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Code block text on code-bg (15.7:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand blue: the highlight on light grounds, outlines of a key tile, the step arrows.

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Labels on dark; chip and tile outlines on light; end of the accent-text gradient.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Supporting blue, and what any pink in a source becomes.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: The highlight on dark grounds (12.4:1 on ink); start of the accent-text gradient.

tokens.name: dream
tokens.usage: Labels and step numbers on light; the purple depth in bg-indigo.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: The only warm accent: one tile or one mark per asset, with ink text on it (15:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Deep navy: dark grounds, code blocks, the darkest stop of the dark gradients.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles inside glass cards and step tiles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Body and leads on a page (17px on phones).

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Uppercase tags above a title, in primary.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: The headline of a slide, hero or cover; one word may take accent-text.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.usage: One or two sentences under the headline, in text-muted, at most 760px wide.

styles.name: slide-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above the headline, in label.

styles.name: slide-pill
styles.usage: Uppercase tags in outlined pills at the bottom of a slide.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Labels inside the art on a slide, in label.

gradient.note: One accent gradient per asset. The pair-* gradients are the placeholder generator's six pairs; the bg-* gradients are the dark grounds for slides, heroes and covers.

tokens.name: pair-1
tokens.usage: Electric blue to aqua; also the explainer's accent gradient.

tokens.name: pair-2
tokens.usage: Deep navy to blue.

tokens.name: pair-3
tokens.usage: Ink to primary.

tokens.name: pair-4
tokens.usage: Navy to soft blue.

tokens.name: pair-5
tokens.usage: Cobalt to aqua.

tokens.name: pair-6
tokens.usage: Teal to aqua to periwinkle, the one three-stop pair.

tokens.name: bg-light
tokens.usage: PRIMARY ground for every format: the page fading into the periwinkle wash. Slides: data-bg="light" in the hero template.

tokens.name: bg-midnight
tokens.usage: Dark ground (secondary), first choice when an asset is dark: darkest, for dense or technical content.

tokens.name: bg-indigo
tokens.usage: Dark ground (secondary), first choice when an asset is dark: adds dream purple depth.

tokens.name: bg-navy
tokens.usage: Dark ground, after midnight and indigo: variety within a dark set.

tokens.name: bg-cobalt
tokens.usage: Dark ground, after midnight and indigo: brightest, when a brighter dark ground is asked for.

tokens.name: bg-deepsea
tokens.usage: Dark ground, after midnight and indigo: cooler, blue-teal.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: One headline word on a dark slide, as clipped text.

tokens.name: card-shadow
tokens.usage: The soft blue shadow under a glass card on a light page.

tokens.name: radius-code
tokens.usage: Code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Command and step tiles inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Glass cards and panels (the brand's large radii run 22 to 32px).

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: A framed example image inside a page.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags and pills.

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between pills, chips and tiles.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Padding inside a glass card.

tokens.name: space-slide
tokens.usage: Left inset of the copy on a 1920 x 1080 slide.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: Every outline: chips, tiles, pills, and line art at 1.5px on screen.

tokens.name: stroke-card
tokens.usage: The white border of a glass card.
